Temporal focus:

T2. Forward-looking reporting short-term risks (next few weeks/months) [YES] — deal closing timeline, debt repayment, shareholder payout
T3. Forward-looking reporting long-term risks (next quarters/years) [NO]

Synopsis:
GoPro (GPRO) is being acquired by Starman Optical in an all-cash deal valued at $285M (~$1.14/share), representing a 29.5% premium to its last close. Shareholders retain ~10% equity in the combined entity. GoPro's ~$92M debt will be fully repaid at closing. Starman Optical operates in fiber-optic signal devices, a sector benefiting from AI infrastructure buildout. GoPro had previously engaged Oliver Wyman to explore strategic alternatives beyond its declining action-camera business.
